SRC-275:R005.text: Cross-cutting root cause This record is better explained as a control-plane separation failure than as a blanket model-quality problem. The protocol correctly generated precise refusals at least twice. ZAICODE exposed unrestricted Bash/Edit/Write tools with mode:yolo; the executor could still run raw mutations or cross into another repository. Meanwhile an observed response contract had no mechanical delivery validation, and the prompt dispatcher sometimes conflated fresh missions with persisted continuation. A model can do excellent product work yet still corrupt audit provenance if policy is carried only as model text. The remedy is not “ask the operator every seven days if things passed.” It is to make denied effects unexecutable, require scoped admission for cross-repo work, and demand real acceptance evidence.
